# Post-SQLFix: Property-Guided Repair of LLM-Generated SQL with Runtime Verification

[All reading notes](../reading-notes.md) · [Catalog entry](../README.md#post-sqlfix)

**Full paper read · 2026-11-09**

[Original source](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.41472v1) · arXiv v1, 30 October 2026

**Reading coverage:** All 35 pages: main sections 1–8, formal definitions/proofs, Algorithms 1–3, experimental tables and dialect analysis; Appendix A complete examples and repair prompts P1–P9.

## Research question

Execution-error feedback gives incomplete repair guidance, and a model may fix one SQL defect while deleting useful structure or reintroducing an earlier error.

## Method

Post-SQLFix canonicalizes SQL, diagnoses syntax, structural and schema/type violations, and constrains repair candidates with explicit edit contracts. A monitor accepts only transitions that reduce violation count, preserve protected components and avoid recurring resolved violations. A separate optional heuristic substitutes columns for empty-result predicates.

## Evaluation

Gen-SQL and TA-SQL are evaluated on BIRD, Spider and BIRD Mini-Dev under SQLite, MySQL and PostgreSQL, with six repair proposers. Full-pipeline integration includes upstream schema-linking checks; repair-only comparisons, component/rule ablations, residual errors and token/iteration counts isolate different effects.

## What the results support

The TA-SQL 7B repair-only experiment reduces EF’s remaining execution failures from 72 to 16, a 77.8% reduction, with fewer rounds and tokens. The largest 11.6-point execution-accuracy gain comes from full-pipeline integration. The monitor intercepts all observed out-of-contract proposals in the reported experiments.

## Limits and qualifications

The formal guarantees concern the declared rule family and edit boundaries, not intended semantics or successful repair. Window constructs and some other SQL forms are outside scope; FK-connectivity assumptions are stricter than general SQL validity. Empty results can be legitimate, and selecting the first nonempty replacement column is explicitly heuristic. Mini-Dev overlaps BIRD-Dev, so evaluation settings are not independent corpora.

## Relevance to reliable Text-to-SQL

A useful mechanism for preventing detectable repair regressions, with a clear boundary between structural verification, semantic correctness and heuristic answer-changing recovery.
